mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% and rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in the past month, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers a flight to quality in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0 and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0 and rises > 0.2pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a weakening demand environment that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of slowing industrial production (INDPRO < 109.0) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250), supply chain disruptions and cost-push inflation reduce corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes increase the cost of capital, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
